name: scratch-card
title: Scratch Card
description: Scratch-off card that reveals content underneath.

meta.interaction: Drag across the surface to erase the overlay and uncover the prize.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: Fires once when the cleared area passes revealThreshold

props.name: onProgress
props.description: Fires with the cleared ratio (0–1) while scratching

props.name: revealThreshold
props.description: Cleared ratio (0–1) that triggers the full reveal. Default 0.5

props.name: brushSize
props.description: Scratch brush diameter in pixels. Default 28

props.name: overlayLabel
props.description: Text printed on the foil surface

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the scratch surface

props.name: revealAnnouncement
props.description: Announced to screen readers when the content is revealed
